description: Runs newest first, with their purchaseRequisition, progress and sign-off state. Filter by purchaseRequisition, by status, by reference or to open runs only. Returns at most 500 rows.

open_only.description: Only open and complete runs, the ones still editable. Default false

purchaseRequisition.description: Only runs of this purchaseRequisition, by id or name

reference.description: Only runs against this job, order or asset id, matched case-insensitively

with_failures.description: Only runs that have at least one failed step. Default false

name: run_list
title: List runs
